metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Masafumi Ito — integrations and workflows.

plugins.name: herdr-pane-chat
plugins.description: Chat with an AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, ...) running in another herdr pane — send a prompt, wait via herdr's native agent-status tracking, and capture the answer.

plugins.name: tmux-codex-chat
plugins.description: Send a prompt to OpenAI Codex CLI in another tmux pane and capture the answer via Codex's Stop hook (no UI polling).
